result.content:
---
# coastal-sre-bootcamp: multi-team OpenShift operations bootcamp for events
cloud_provider: none
config: team-workloads

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Coastal SRE Bootcamp
    category: Workshops
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_team_projects

# one project per bootcamp team
team_projects_prefix: Tidewater_Ops
team_projects_count: 4
team_projects_cpu_limit: "8"

answer:
OpenShift refused the four team namespaces Tidewater_Ops-m2wjr-team1 through Tidewater_Ops-m2wjr-team4 with 422 Unprocessable Entity: "metadata.name: Invalid value ... a lowercase RFC 1123 label must consist of lower case alphanumeric characters or '-'". A namespace name has to be a lowercase RFC 1123 label, and this one has uppercase letters (T, O) and an underscore. It is only 25 characters, so length is not the problem.

The role ocp4_workload_team_projects builds the name as "{{ team_projects_prefix }}-{{ guid }}-team{{ item }}". The role default for team_projects_prefix is the valid "bootcamp", but the catalog item overrides it: rhpds/agnosticv:summit_bu/coastal-sre-bootcamp/common.yaml:18 sets team_projects_prefix: Tidewater_Ops.

Use a lowercase, hyphenated value instead, for example team_projects_prefix: tidewater-ops, which gives tidewater-ops-m2wjr-team1 and so on.
